name: LHA
description_en: Light Home Automation application that is fully extensible using Blockly, HTML or Lua. It includes extensions such as ConBee, Philips Hue or Z-Wave JS. `MIT` `Lua`
readme_preview:
lha is a light home automation application

The lha application allows to * enrich your existing gateway such as the [Hue](https://www.philips-hue.com/) bridge * record and display historical device values such as temperature * interact between incompatible protocols such as _ZigBee_ and _Z-Wave_ * compose advanced automations using [Blockly](https://developers.google.com/blockly/) scripts * design web views using [HTML](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/) and [Vue.js](https://v2.vuejs.org/) *...
